INSERT INTO announce_errors (
                    user_id,
                    info_hash,
                    torrent_id,
                    error_code,
                    peer_id,
                    occurrences,
                    first_seen_at,
                    last_seen_at
                )
                SELECT
                    t.user_id,
                    t.info_hash,
                    torrents.id,
                    t.error_code,
                    t.peer_id,
                    t.occurrences,
                    t.first_seen_at,
                    t.last_seen_at
                FROM unnest(
                    $1::int[],
                    $2::bytea[],
                    $3::int[],
                    $4::announce_error_code_enum[],
                    $5::bytea[],
                    $6::bigint[],
                    $7::timestamptz[],
                    $8::timestamptz[]
                ) AS t(
                    user_id,
                    info_hash,
                    torrent_id,
                    error_code,
                    peer_id,
                    occurrences,
                    first_seen_at,
                    last_seen_at
                )
                JOIN users ON users.id = t.user_id
                LEFT JOIN torrents ON torrents.id = t.torrent_id
                ON CONFLICT (user_id, info_hash) DO UPDATE SET
                    torrent_id = EXCLUDED.torrent_id,
                    error_code = EXCLUDED.error_code,
                    peer_id = EXCLUDED.peer_id,
                    occurrences = announce_errors.occurrences + EXCLUDED.occurrences,
                    last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at
